text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On our day out, Tokai Teio seems to be
worrying
over something.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well... The thing is, Prez gave me an
assignment...
choice_data_list: 何かあったのか？
何かあったの？
choice_data_list_en: Did something happen?
Did something happen?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I really am a genius! ♪ Another
scrimmage in the
bag!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Since enrolling here, I've been whittling
down my
times. If I just keep this up...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:

than I
thought! Don't you think so too,
Prez?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you keep this up? ...Fail to grasp the
true
reality of your situation, and that
momentum will
one day fade.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?! What do you mean?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
You still have a long way to go... The
road to the
top is far longer and harder
than you imagine.
You have much left to
learn.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
If you truly seek to become stronger,
then... Let's
see, now. How about I give
you an assignment?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And then she told me to figure out "what
my
trainer means to me."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:

place!

you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

assignment.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

go-karts! ♪

and, before
we know it, the sun has
already begun to set.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio

Trainer, do

now?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
